# Language-eval comparison (generated by summarize_results.py)

Scores are four-choice next-word selections (1 = correct answer has the highest
probability; ties and unscorable cases get 0). Coverage = cases whose prompt and all four
choices are in the model's vocabulary. Free continuations are sampled separately
(temperature 0.8, fixed per-case seed) and are not scored.
